newsitem.title: USA: Handy & Harman sees Q4 near 95Q4's $0.18/shr.
newsitem.headline: Handy & Harman sees Q4 near 95Q4's $0.18/shr.

text.p: Handy & Harman said on Monday that it expects its continuing operations earnings in the fourth quarter to approximate last year's fourth quarter results.
The company reported $0.18 earnings per share for the 1995 fourth quarter. On Monday, it reported third quarter operating profits of $0.41 per share, up from the year-ago quarter.
The company said several operating units are now experiencing softness in the market, mainly because of a slowdown in the semiconductor and automotive industries.
"We anticipate the continuing operations earnings for the balance of this year will approximate last year's fourth quarter results," the company stated.

The company said later that its restated 1995 fourth quarter results were $0.16 per share. The results were restated to include the 1996 sale of its refining division as required, said Controller Dennis Kelly.
